notes.title: Medea joins Mostroscopy!
notes.notes: [p]Medea, The Kitten of Tindalos arrives at Mostroscopy![/p][p][/p][p]Medea is a kitten who turned into stone after the death of her human, a witch named Alejandra... now she's smelled something beyond time and space, and has awakened to go find it![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/ef5c18632fe3ed53a0c069dadc3cbaf228d12083.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Medea is a very agile kitten with very varied skills, a Rushdown type fighter that can transform during some of her attacks.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/1d97345473cd2849f10b9c9816316ad760e0953b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And is just Like Dollores one of the smallest fighters in the roster[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/62e7214ef9362013857437123a7460ad84656537.jpg"][/img][/p][p]She's based on the short story [b][i]The Hounds of Tindalos[/i][/b] by Frank Belknap Long and the Mexican film [b][i]Blacker than Night[/i][/b] by Carlos Enrique Taboada, a national horror classic![/p][p][/p][p]Wow! It's been a lot of work getting here, but we already have four of the six fighters that make up the Mostroscopy Year 2 Season Pass.[/p][p][/p][p]We're just working on the last two fighters.[/p][p]The console port team is working to bring the DLC characters to consoles. Just bear with us, we're a little slow.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/d64cd0fec641019c2eddafa83ddb8c5cff8cb117.jpg"][/img][/p][p]And stay tuned! The season of the supernatural and mystery is almost here... and next Halloween, Mostroscopy will be celebrating its 2nd anniversary![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Dollores joins the roster!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p]Dollores, the possessed doll, arrives in Mostroscopy on July 11th![/p][p]The third DLC character for Mostroscopy's second year is searching for the witch Vladislava to settle the score... Who is Dollores? What is its tragic past? You'll soon discover it in its story mode.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/4eb30b423ac9f1ee60c84c1f9362b39d1b0ddf83.png"][/img][/p][p]Dolores attacks with its hair, which has grown supernaturally longer than normal, like a famous Japanese doll... [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/1449c14a1c44287a24dc47ca7d919783b1b995cf.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Throws punches like a pro and can propel itself on air or land![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/8749f23147a1527740d411e57c0b9f3f2411a20e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]it also have superhuman strength and telekinetic powers that allow it to levitate objects around itself or throw heavy stones at its opponents, it also has a rather aggressive attitude, rare in such a sweet-looking doll.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/60e934d25b4dbf120fc0b3657c265b97ab08c6f9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It also comes with its own stage, "The Island of the Dolls," which is actually a real, very spooky place in Mexico.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/feb9f7fb14302b697bc44ccaf869a92a5ea29996.png"][/img][/p][p]Also, be sure to check out its Challenge Mode challenges, as I think they're a bit difficult, according to some people.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks playing Mostroscopy, and we're still working on console ports so we can bring the season pass characters to different platforms![/p]

notes.title: May with "M" from Mostroscopy
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've been working like there's no tomorrow on Mostroscopy for all these months!

The first big launch was the XBOX version on January 31st, which has had a big reception since then! thank you very much!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/ba15309ddad22bc5b278a13fc5749441684c429b.png[/img]

later at the beginning of March we launched the season pass of year 2 and the first character in it, Vladislava, the slavic witch!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/9254b6c307d553c47044144e95422f7a398900ef.jpg[/img]

We are finishing the new fighter that will join the roster on May 9th and who will be the second fighter of the season pass, Camazotz, the Vampire god, who some people confuse with the mythological Chupacabra!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/09e86ebf735ea00d7bb1b21c448e4e4b86c16b70.png[/img]

With him comes his story mode and challenges, as well as the mysterious Council of World Vampires...

Plus, we're printing volume two of the comic, which tells us more about Toshiro Murayama Drakenhausen, Kitty, Faust V, and... Luzbelle?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/e3b359dd4234281a80ffe64b99f1d16bc5cbb46e.png[/img]

This comic will be available in physical form in limited quantities, but we'll also be selling it digitally like issue 1.

We also created some original art for some events...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/6c371812dfbec84e20cd3d8984be30e8aab528cd.png[/img]

These postcards were designed for an event at the university where I work, to encourage registration for a Mostroscopy tournament to raise funds for a photography event.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/7da76afee311d14e8627695905e9ee327dd3b891.png[/img]

And this other art is for a Mostroscopy fan who will be wearing it on an incredible t-shirt at Evo Japan next May 9th... the same day Camazotz is released as a fighter!!

Also, stay tuned to the networks [url=https://www.instagram.com/oribe_ware/]OribeWare[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/seashell_studio/]Seashell studio[/url], especially on Instagram, as there will be content all month long, and there we will announce other exciting news about a greater reach of the game in relation to the gaming community!

And finally, at the end of the month we'll be at CCXP Mexico! This is a pretty big comics convention, and we'll be bringing comics, Mostroscopy codes, posters, figurines, pins, mugs, and we'll see what else we can come up with!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/a78adee428382a1221ed76c1e4949a8d99aad24a.png[/img]

So stay tuned for this May with M for Mostroscopy!!

notes.title: New content is coming to Mostroscopy and the Year 2 Season Pass!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

After several months of hard work creating new content and also bringing Mostroscopy to consoles, we want to announce that new content is finally coming to the game with new characters!

The first character to join the roster is Vladislava, a Slavic witch who seeks revenge against DrakenHaussen and is also a renowned actress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/9254b6c307d553c47044144e95422f7a398900ef.jpg[/img]

Vladislava uses powerful kicks in which she turns her legs into crow claws, she can also detach her legs and use them as missiles or generate propulsion from her knees... it's really strange, but based on Mexican Folklore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/6a4f1f2fd45ffcc97c897d1c7720a59420cf4c57.jpg[/img]

Her Stage also arrives, the Cabaret "Stupa" which in Russian means Mortar... yes, like that tool that witches use to grind herbs and other things.

We would have loved to be able to release Vladislava as free content, but with the time costs and bringing Mostroscopy to consoles and other events we're going to this year, things were getting a little tricky from a money standpoint...

She'll cost $1.99 USD (check the exchange rate in your local currency) and so will the following characters... that's right! More fighters are coming!!

On the same day Vladislava arrives in Mostroscopy, you can also purchase the Season Pass, which will give you access to all the characters coming this year for $7.99 USD, and since it consists of 6 characters, you basically get two free fighters if you pre-purchase the content, Thank you very much!!

Who will be the new fighters this year?

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3548030/Mostroscopy__Year_2_Season_Pass/]Pueden ver mas información sobre el pase de temporada aquí[/url]

Remember that if you buy the season pass, it already includes Vladislava, so don't buy the same content twice. The ability to buy individual characters is just in case someone isn't interested in buying all the fighters or there is one they don't like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/c28b85362bc4b09f56a2f9cd4b9f46a63d2c0770.jpg[/img]

We also have a rebalance of the characters, since now they have "Guard Push" so when a movement is blocked, the opponent is pushed a little further away from the attacker, this prevents the abuse of very fast movements and gives time to breathe if you are under a lot of pressure.

We have also implemented the Steam remote Play together option, which is a native Steam option that allows multiple players to play remotely, in case you want to play online but the connection and the Mostroscopy options are not to your liking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/9c7cdd264e0e93aa394622a97f93f962dd7495f7.png[/img]

Thanks your very much for playing Mostroscopy this last year and we start the updates next March 7th!

notes.title: Mostroscopy Patch 2.9

Mostroscopy Patch 2.9 is now live, also known as the Post Xbox Patch, and well, what can we say, if you have an XBOX you can now enjoy Mostroscopy there too!!

[previewyoutube=Cp9lfywNc0Y;full][/previewyoutube]

We are very happy with this, as it is our second game coming to console, after Combate Monero which is also available on Playstation in addition to Steam!

We were very busy these months making the console port, and we had to optimize many resources and elements of the game, and that was reflected in the quality of some filters in the steam version.

We have already created a new variation of a quality script that adjusts it to the console and steam versions, so if you check the game now it should look better, as it again has ambient occlusion shadows in the game. :)

And we also changed the little mistake wich made Japanese the default language in the Main menu. sorry, it should be in english now.

Also, there's a little preview in the jukebox section for the next character... hang on a little longer and new characters, balance and hopefully more stuff will start arriving, also the number 2 of the comic will be available soon as a new DLC :)

notes.title: Mostroscopy update 2.8!
notes.notes:
Good evening! Today we bring you Mostroscopy update 2.8.

This update includes fixes to some unblockable combos, fixes to fonts and Japanese language handling, changes to the training mode GUI, and also an adjustment to the characters' basic movements that I hope will make the game more dynamic:

By connecting a normal movement and canceling it into a special one, the animation is faster, and that opens up possibilities for new combos :)

Any comments can be written here or on our Discord!

notes.title: A New Mostroscopy Version Arrives!!
notes.notes:
Good afternoon everyone, we are working on adding more features to Mostroscopy and fixing bugs, balance, online play... ugh, but we are a small team and that takes us a lot of time.

Tomorrow, December 2nd, the comic Mostroscopy #1 goes on sale. This comic expands the lore of the game's universe a bit (at least you'll know a bit more about Vampire Woman, Yotecatl, Dr. Tengu Piscuario, Luzbelle and Faust 4) wich we published physically in a very short print about 9 months ago.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/5853f957c1f2a3a3d17bc3a7c3baedac4699199d.jpg[/img]

Well, we're finally releasing it in digital format through Steam, we hope you like it!

In addition to the comic release we've been working on other versions of the game... Wink, Wink. We'll have more information next year (as soon as possible I hope!) and of course the new content of the game that will arrive next year, which as you know is season 2 of characters, and we're already working on the stages and models, as well as fighting styles and stories... the roster is already decided, and there will be content for the WHOLE year :)

you know what? here's a little peek of one of the characters:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/3ea5c41908ecdaf331c140decddbe4a794a41491.jpg[/img]

hehe, not much of a spoiler i guess.

We are also working on comic #2 and another book related to the topic.

I hope you like it and continue supporting Mostroscopy next year!

notes.title: UPDATE 2.4
notes.notes:
Good evening everyone!

Mostroscopy patch 2.4 is now ready!!

This Patch includes several important changes:
[list]
[*] There are a lot of bugs and rebalancing in many many moves, you can see a more detailed list on our Discord.
[*] Evangeline, Eda and Yolanda are now selectable through the game! Finish the game with Faust, Vampire Woman, Yotecatl, Piscuario, Kitty and Drakkenhaussen to unlock Evangeline
[*] Finish the game with Luzbelle, Penumbra, La Llorona and Charro Negro to unlock Eda and Yolanda.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/b547d39a771b9ef2ab359c30c72e2dcd70813509.jpg[/img]

[*] All characters now have their own Story Mode, so you can find out more details about each character's Lore!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/e21ffa4d32bc250580a1991c912cef26cf88f11a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/faeb3fb93e18794f2c61de4e44c582a95f89bbf6.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/7ea29468d71fee81c204d8390330474885ff68dd.jpg[/img]

[*] There are many characters appearing in this mode... will any of them make it to the roster?
[*] Online Mode has some changes, we fixed some issues with the back and rematch buttons, and we added back the server selection option.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/a2b1a64861ed9b890fc77a86ccd6f34650749a26.jpg[/img]

[*] Faust V's stage has some minor visual changes, as the visual effects were a bit heavy and didn't work very well on all hardware. For the time being, it's now simpler.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/f5b4f24080f1cbee02cbccefe996a6a58e2a2439.jpg[/img]

[*] A slight gameplay change, the Guard Cancel that was performed by pressing attack or special while guarding can now only be done with the special button.
[*] We have added the Jukebox option, where you can listen to the songs in the game and see their titles and authors.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/2ac5b5136a348a6cc0dec354e19fb4a7a7fdfc85.jpg[/img]
[*] There are a couple of new trophies, "Link to the past" and "Children of the night", hopefully you can unlock them!
[/list]

I think that's all that matters for now, we will continue adding new options, but in the meantime we hope you enjoy this update!!

notes.title: Lisa arrives in Mostroscopy
notes.notes:
A new fighter arrives at Mostroscopy and she is none other than Lisa, a Ghost nurse strongly based on the Mexican legend of La Planchada... and on a famous series of horror games.

[previewyoutube=smWv0d0LMiA;full][/previewyoutube]

Lisa has a wide variety of weapons that she can use in combat such as her ever-trusty rusty steel pipe and knife combo.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/e43ce69ca4f8c009ab1c0022f3d676b1af291c06.png[/img]

A giant syringe to move around the stage
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/0b65382cb064508f0f786970bf5e3609f0404e88.png[/img]

A Gun (curiously a LeMat revolver, the same one used by El Charro Negro)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/674a2e3ee39f3d1a185bb3e02c99641d8ccaced9.png[/img]

She can swing reminding us of a certain Francis Bacon Painting
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/cf66d479f24c3722d9934a033ba5788057fcc217.png[/img]

or even summon Helpers to fight!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/89aad167b5b1c77a6f16b6d3d0bdd0cceb0a1718.png[/img]

I hope you like Lisa's abilities and have fun using her in combat, we have paid a lot of attention to detail when making references with her movements and attacks to another series or trivial details. 
Curiously, Lisa is the character with the most Taunts in the game, in one of them she pulls out a portable radio and you can hear several different conversations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/56783d35217435a18be7815e0d7c2c5d94e40322.png[/img]

Of course, you can play with her in Arcade and discover her story (apparently she is being manipulated by a secret sect) and finish her challenges in Challenge mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/492d95e3641eb31c1ff6984358124ac3733c004b.png[/img]

But Lisa's update also includes some other things:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/7270f164ad3976af9f8aff3929518246d8183de8.png[/img]

[list]
[*] We have changed the internal input handling system, so now we use the Rewired library, which allows greater flexibility when configuring your controls.
[*] We've added a "success" text when finishing a combo challenge, which makes it clearer to know if you've made progress.
[*] Of course, Lisa has her own stage, the Real del Monte Mining Hospital
[*] New trophies for Lisa, for winning the arcade mode, for finishing her challenges and a third achievement that is a... jojo Reference?
[/list]

I hope you enjoy playing with Lisa, it will be available next June 27th!

See you soon with the last character of this first set!

notes.title: Next Fighter arrives for summer!
notes.notes:
We are putting the final details on a new fighter for Mostroscopy that will arrive very soon. 
The third character of our initial 4 fighters expansion will arrive in the first days of summer, and she is nourished by a deep-rooted Mexican legend, although curiously not so exploited in the cinema; It is a legend that is present in almost all hospitals in Mexico, where someone appears at the edge of the night to do their job...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/de938be50d8cfaee9a6fe0a100745cd019af4a86.png[/img]

Of course our fighter also draws from other sources and visual references, based on other games and local legends from the place where we work, here is a photo:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/5468b328c5b635f76541cba209918707c0eb0223.png[/img]

So you can get an idea... I hope to upload a trailer soon before the launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/e22c858c4abe46482ca53afd2a4709a5d6ef6203.jpg[/img]

Thanks for reading and be alert!

notes.title: Toshiro Murayama joins Mostroscopy
notes.notes:
Toshiro Murayama has arrived at Mostroscopy!

This new fighter comes from very distant lands looking for something... or someone. He is accompanied by his faithful dog Godo.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/c4f003cdbfe2e6a4fa1d42f7f5780215252c29b3.png[/img]

Toshiro fights with a Katana and uses the fighting style called Iaido, the quick draw, in some movements he is supported by Godo and some quite interesting combinations can be made.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/a5883c4d23e89ebb0a6b9c077fc4db074acfae2d.png[/img]

Toshiro's stage is called Haus and apparently it takes place in Japan, but the truth is that it is in some undetermined place in Mexico (Possibly San Luis Potosí... why is that?)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/2cd3e332b429d15071ff0b7be68b4b4fd375f6fa.png[/img]
It's a Japanese-style village where there is a possessed house that's alive... that sounds like a movie to me... there are some monsters in the background, and a cameo in the well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/9e328c2ed136f3cae30258cd70653ed0dcac2f24.png[/img]

In addition to the new fighter, some other adjustments have been made to the game

[list]
[*] DrakenHaussen and Kukamon both had an infinite combo with their jumping projectiles, but now they have an animation when they hit the ground, so these combos are no longer possible.
[*] Luzbelle has very basic voice clips in her normal attacks.
[*] All fighters have a little less life, so the fights are a little shorter.
[*] Mostro Mode no longer ends with a display and a pause, now you regain control of the character immediately.
[*] There are new challenges for Toshiro and Kukamon, with their respective trophies.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/110e2a0c69613d3534432c6015a55584fc16e2de.png[/img]

This update took us a little longer, but it was due to the feedback we received at the La Mole 2024 event, I hope you like it.

Now we will continue with the next fighter...

notes.title: A new fighter aproaches from a distant land
notes.notes:
A new fighter is approaching Mostroscopy and those who attend La Mole comic con 2024 will be able to meet him first!

That's right, the second post-launch fighter will be available this weekend, March 15, 16 and 17 at the La Mole comic con in Mexico City at the WTC

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/4607f477d7e722fc02e32c3aa9e672d76cd820f1.png[/img]

This new fighter comes from distant lands and uses an exotic sword and his faithful friend Godo

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/6443ad8cf06f656f70eb1bac91d42f701a6bb8c3.png[/img]

We are finishing the final details but those who go to the Mole will be able to try him first, and it will be available soon in the Steam release!

so if you are near Mexico City, visit our Stand!

notes.title: Kukamon the Inhuman robot joins the Roster
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/2ac7376e339695f5ba18e2fb6381feb4996f59f5.jpg[/img]

Mostrocopy's first Post-Launch Character is here! Kukamon the inhuman robot!

Kukamon is a somewhat heavy character like Penumbra and Yotecatl, but that doesn't mean he can't move relatively easily on the stage, his "forward+attack" Move in the air, crouching and "forward+special" are quite good for covering distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/8740cf598cdaa95773591fc5d9294de77b3097d0.jpg[/img]

Also with him comes his stage "The Laboratory of Dr. Cadillac" with its variants in Black and White and Technicolor.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/fb09bd7013a3094e07c866bc696018c7cca093fd.jpg[/img]

Also, a new trophy can be unlocked by finishing the arcade ladder with Kukamon and seeing its ending.
There is another trophy for passing its Challenge mode, but we will add that one shortly. :)

In addition to that, all characters have post-fight phrases in Arcade mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/16c065ff27b604335e1937bbde09b89c0dd27145.png[/img]

So those who wanted a little more Lore about the game will be able to find several references in these dialogues, which by doing the math are just over 150 different phrases!

Likewise, in Arcade mode there is one more match per fighter, so to finish it they will have to overcome 6 opponents, instead of the previous 5, since there were those who asked for more fights.

I hope you have fun! Leave your comments about Kukamon or the Game, Thank you very much!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/bd5a39c0fd704ea64489a32de94923f5bfd4f816.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Kukamon the inhuman robot
notes.notes:
Kukamon, the first post-launch fighter of the game is almost ready. It is a retro-futuristic style robot created by Dr. Cadillac, who also created the fighter Penumbra.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/4fcc75cdec595e61a178cb44478e69f578b4f8dd.jpg[/img]

Kukamon is a heavy fighter but still faster than Yotecatl and Penumbra, using his heavy metal body and ice attacks to fight his way through the fight.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/a554e08cb6932478dda56e0a7a8802d9d9760599.jpg[/img]

In addition to it's movements, we have to make reactions to the other characters' throws... it's ending, challenge mode challenges and art, so finishing the animations is just part of the job.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44665192/7aabd611e16ea34e76b4cbb0c8701049858bdaff.jpg[/img]

Even so, it will be ready soon and we will add it as free extra content to the game with the new update!

notes.title: New content coming soon!
notes.notes:
Thank you very much for the good reception that Mostroscopy has had upon its Release!

We've had very good comments about the gameplay, the artistic style of the game and particularly the character design.

We still have several ideas that we want to implement in the game, starting with new fighters that will join the roster; To begin with, 4 fighters are already planned, and since we were busy with the launch, we will start working on them in these months, hoping to release the first one at the beginning of next year :)

Thank you very much for playing Mostroscopy and stay tuned for this and more content!
